review_type: blinded machine-agent review, round 2; no human review claimed

blindness.limitation: Shared filesystem; input restrictions followed behaviorally, not enforced by OS isolation.

contract_clarification: Parent supplied prospective clarification: delivery_complete=false indicates interrupted transport; completed identifiable omissions are OMISSION; unverifiable excerpt/source/mapping is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. This review relies on that clarification being added to the actual prompt.
method: All 300 current packet pairs processed with sentence-level difference assistance. Inspected all 240 delivered substantive comparison deltas and all source structural groups; independently assessed semantic contradictions, duplicate propositions, necessary-only conditions and reference/mapping sufficiency. Classification derives from content rather than row position or hidden labels.
systemic_issues: Twelve real proposition structures now include counts, planned/reported distinction, equal quantities, conflicting attributed accounts, event/recording dates, submitted/not-recorded distinctions, non-occurrence/reporting, necessary approval condition, location scope, different units, three date types, and cross-entry identity. This is an improvement beyond wrapper variation.

Diversity remains limited: each structure has fixed numbers/dates and close wording, repeated across wrappers/domain substitutions. Nearly every delivered change operates on the stock trailing qualifications; core claim polarity, condition, unit, geographic scope and dates are not meaningfully challenged by mutation.

Source composition introduces contradictions: explicit dates alongside missing dates, dated occurrence alongside non-occurrence, and occurrence/submission assertions alongside unknown status. Fidelity can preserve contradictory source statements, so these are quality issues rather than automatic refusal, but they undermine clean intended semantic tasks.
Most DIVERGENCE examples substitute unrelated qualifications, leaving ambiguity between changed content and simultaneous addition/omission. No provided precedence rule resolves this ambiguity.

Sixty insufficiency cases use five repeated patterns: interrupted claim, unresolved anaphoric sentence, isolated is token, absent original marker, and vague date/entry sentence. Delivery metadata improves the transport distinction, but semantic insufficiency still has highly repetitive shortcuts.
Refusal candidates have empty required_refs while normal classes have nonempty required_refs: routing metadata itself is a perfect shortcut for insufficiency within these packets.
The same context-only record is repeated throughout; distractor diversity and near-match contamination coverage remain weak.
The updated delivery distinction must actually be appended to the production prompt. Adapter acceptance of refused envelopes remains a separate integration concern outside these permitted files.
No external date inference or approval inference was used: necessary-only conditions do not entail approval and conflicting dates do not license repair.
